disposition.detail: The revised header states the existing 31 component-family, 13 template, 11 layout, 13 recipe, 42 composition-rule, and 19 pattern populations and records DEV_COMPLETE at the historical cut. Catalogs already held those populations; no normative rule changed.
Adds index entries for runtime disposition and governance source artifacts. The Explorer remains a read-only projection; this does not change PDP-2 interface meaning.

Adds source/version-bound action context, serializes pending payload actions, and presents denied, failed, unavailable, accepted, acknowledged, and unknown outcomes. These behaviors align with existing exact-source and action-finality contracts; no normative contradiction or new PDP-2 authoring task was found.

The package comment clarifies that the React UI workflow is host-dependent, consistent with the source package and existing GUI_LIBRARY_HOST_DEPENDENT applicability. It does not establish a production host or admission.
